entities.name: MS network capability
entities.description: An information element included by a UE supporting A/Gb mode or Iu mode, unless the UE performs a periodic tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: Periodic tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: A procedure performed by the UE for periodic tracking area updates.

entities.name: UE not performing periodic TAU
entities.description: Condition where the UE is not performing a periodic tracking area updating procedure.

relations.description: The MS network capability IE is included unless the UE performs a periodic tracking area updating procedure.
